events.title: Carlisle Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Organic Revenues Decline Y/Y
events.body: CSL beats Q1 earnings estimates but misses on revenues as sales decline and key segments face weak demand despite modest margin gains.

events.title: CSL Q1 Deep Dive: Margin Expansion Offsets Volume Pressure Amid Price Increases and Input Cost Inflation
